name: Open Nectar Vita
author: bren
description: Unofficial native PS Vita port of Pikmin, built on the Open Nectar decompilation. Requires your own Pikmin (USA) GameCube disc image (iso, gcm, rvz, wia or ciso) placed in ux0:data/Pikmin. Saves are standard GameCube .gci files compatible with Dolphin.
